Id1.text: Approximately 500 employees make up the academic staff at Acharya Institute of Technology, a Technical Campus designated by the All India Council for Technical Education of Mumbai, affiliated with the Visvesvaraya Technological University of Belgaum, and directed by Dr. G.P. Prabhukumar at Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090.

Id2.text: The Acharya Institute of Technology campus is located in Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090. The Institute, which is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University in Belgaum, employs about 500 academic staff. The director is Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar. Acharya Institute of Technology was given the Technical Campus status by the All India Council for Technical Education, which is located in Mumbai.
